handoff.salientSummary: User-testing round 1 for guest-channels-and-crm: 181 assertions tested by 21 flow-validator groups (28 flow reports) → 175 pass, 6 fail, 0 blocked. The four assertions an earlier batch left blocked on the shared book_ip rate bucket were re-tested and pass. Failures: staff availability ignores special days (2), manage links in messages point at the App origin and 404 (2), staff availability is hold-blind (1), report builder hides bookings/waitlist subjects (1).
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Ran the user-testing validation round for milestone guest-channels-and-crm. Determined the 181 pending assertions from the completed features' fulfills mapping, brought up tenant-api US (3007), tenant-api KSA (3009), App (3001) and Sites (3008), seeded acme/riyadh-grill, and normalized the round baseline (large_party_mode=request). Wrote the round block plus per-surface Flow Validator Guidance and a 21-row data-isolation registry into library/user-testing.md, then spawned 21 flow-validator subagents in 7 batches across browser, curl, terminal and mixed surfaces (evidence in evidence/guest-channels-and-crm/, 1206 files). Resolved a systemic blocker (every local client hashes to one client IP, so the shared durable book_ip 20/day bucket starved public writes) by clearing the shared rsv_rate_counters rows and mandating private X-Forwarded-For identities. Re-tested the four assertions that were blocked by that bucket (VAL-ONLINE-013/014/016/040) and they now pass, including a constructed single-unit slot proving a valid hold loses only to a staff overbook. Synthesized 175 pass / 6 fail / 0 blocked, updated validation-state.json (304 passed, 6 failed, 175 pending for later milestones), wrote validation/<milestone>/user-testing/synthesis.json with per-assertion reasons, documented deviations and applied updates, and tore the services down. No product code, tests or config were modified; the repo working tree is clean.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: Nothing in scope for this validation feature. The 6 failed assertions are real product defects for the orchestrator to turn into fix features (see discoveredIssues). Two contract-literal deviations are recorded in synthesis.json rather than silently resolved: VAL-ONLINE-015's same-body retry answers 410 hold_expired instead of 409 (behavior verified via a fresh attempt for the exhausted unit, marked pass) and VAL-ONLINE-032's literal guest_modify_cutoff_min=100000 exceeds the schema max 10080 (reproduced with 10080). VAL-ONLINE-046's same-day alternatives branch cannot render in the Sites flow (flow.ts branch order, already scrutiny-documented), so its alternatives half was verified at the API level only.

commandsRun.observation: First re-test run: VAL-ONLINE-013 pass (201, code KMMTFS43, hold converted, second attempt 410 hold_expired), VAL-ONLINE-014 pass (byte-identical replay 201 with same id/code/token, changed firstName 409 idempotency_conflict, one row), VAL-ONLINE-040 pass (ios/android rows channel=native client=ios/android, web row channel=online). Crashed in the 016 phase: the isolation blocks were created with the book token (403 invalid_scope) and the evidence query used rsv_guests.phone (no such column), so 016 was not valid in that run.

VAL-ONLINE-016 pass: area block returned the known 409 conflict, fallback occupied m3+m4; hold took the single remaining party-8 unit tbl_71be1db7 (G10-T12); staff overbook on it -> 201; guest conversion -> 409 slot_unavailable with alternatives (sameDay 6, otherDates 6), 0 reservation rows for the guest, hold still active (not converted).

181 unique assertion ids: 175 pass, 6 fail, 0 blocked; VAL-REPORT-024 reported by two groups (both pass); failures VAL-ONLINE-007, VAL-CROSS-007, VAL-CROSS-009, VAL-CROSS-011, VAL-MSG-009, VAL-REPORT-014.

tests.coverage: No repository test files were added or modified - this feature is the user-testing validation round, which tests through real user surfaces (browser journeys, curl against tenant-api, terminal/SQL checks) rather than by writing code. Coverage: 181 of the 181 pending guest-channels-and-crm assertions exercised across 21 flow groups (online booking, guest messages, waitlist, guestbook/reports plus cross-milestone regressions), 1206 evidence artifacts.

discoveredIssues.description: Staff/operator availability ignores special days: GET /operator/reservations/book/availability returned 141 slots on two days marked closed/online_closed and POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations created a reservation (201) on a closed day, while public availability correctly answered closed/online_closed. Fails VAL-ONLINE-007 and, through the App booking sheet (slots offered on a closed day, no closed-day warning, overbook without pacing warning), VAL-CROSS-007.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Make the operator availability/booking path load special days the same way the public engine does and refuse slots on closed/online_closed days (or require an explicit override), then re-check the App booking sheet warning/pacing surfaces.

discoveredIssues.description: Guest manage/status links in messages point at the App origin (http://localhost:3001/reserve/manage#t=...) and 404: the App context siteOrigin falls back to ENV.BASE_URL when the org has no custom domain (apps/app/app/routes/resources+/reservations.context.ts:181, consumed by apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-message-service.ts:333). Fails VAL-CROSS-011 and VAL-MSG-009; the token and manage endpoints themselves work.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Build message links from the org's published Sites origin (fall back to the Sites host, not the App BASE_URL) and re-capture a confirmation email to confirm the link resolves.

discoveredIssues.description: Staff availability is hold-blind: with a live guest hold on the slot, GET /operator/reservations/book/availability still returns available:true with suggestedTableIds (VAL-CROSS-009). The staff day feed lists live holds and the booking write path respects them, so a staff booking on a held table is only possible with overbook.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Pass engineHolds into the operator availability read (rsv-booking-service already builds them for writes) so held slots are withheld or flagged.

discoveredIssues.description: The App report builder filters its catalog with staffing grants only - catalogForGrants(fullCatalog, staff.subjects) in apps/app/app/routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/reports+/new.tsx:35, _index.tsx:38 and $reportId.tsx:48 - so bookings and waitlist_entries are missing in the UI although the minted reports token lists them (VAL-REPORT-014).
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Union the reservation grants into the subject filter in all three report routes.

discoveredIssues.description: POST /reservations/requests can leak a raw internal error: when the engine picks a table still held by another pending request it answers 409 with a 'Failed query: insert into "rsv_table_occupancies"' message because pending_approval is missing from ACTIVE_BOOKING_STATUSES (packages/reservations/src/engine/assign.ts:301). Observed by b2 and g5.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Add pending_approval to ACTIVE_BOOKING_STATUSES and map the remaining conflict to the uniform slot_unavailable shape.

discoveredIssues.description: POST /operator/reservations/setup/blocks answers 409 {"error":"conflict","message":"Failed query: insert into rsv_table_occupancies ..."} when the block overlaps existing reservations (area block over Main Dining on 2026-10-21 17:30-19:00), and persists nothing. Workaround used by the retest: occupy the member tables with staff bookings.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Surface a typed conflict (or accept the block with a warning) instead of a raw query error.

discoveredIssues.description: Two contract literals do not match the implementation or schema and were recorded as documented deviations in synthesis.json rather than silently passed: VAL-ONLINE-015 expects a same-body retry to answer 409 slot_unavailable (it answers 410 hold_expired because the hold token is consumed; the 409 is reachable with a fresh hold), and VAL-ONLINE-032 asks for guest_modify_cutoff_min=100000 which exceeds the settings schema max 10080.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Decide whether to reword those two assertions (fresh hold / schema-valid cutoff) in the contract.
